claim_ceiling: Synthetic local-prototype-line sensitivity only. All station times, yields, buffer capacities, variants, failures and repair intervals are invented assumptions. This describes a constrained isolation-milled prototype route, not conventional PCB manufacture; it assumes unplated holes and cannot claim plated vias, multilayer, production solder mask/finish, RF capability, cost superiority or physical production qualification.
